title: KittyMod
description: silly hypixel skyblock utility mod i dev when im bored :3
body:
### silly hypixel skyblock utility mod i dev when im bored :3
**this mod includes:**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


1. **automeow (meow when another player meows in chat)**
2. **autowoof (woof when another player woofs in chat)**
3. **phoenix pet message (changes the phoenix pet from saying "saved you from Certain Death" to something else)**
4. **colored chats (allows colored text to be used in chat using minecraft color codes)**
5. **rank hider (hides everyones rank in chat, including your own. also works on fakepixel)**
6. **hide discord warning (hides the annoying warning when someone mentions discord in chat)**
7. **shorter chat types (shortens hypixel's chat types. for example: Party would become [PC]. also works on fakepixel)**
8. **disable empty lines (hides empty lines and excess whitespace from the chat)**
9. **hide fire sales (hides the "FIRE SALE" message from the chat)**
10. **phoenix pet cooldown (adds a bar at the top of your screen to show the phoenix pet's rekindle ability cooldown)**
11. **glassorite (replaces the pillars in F7/M7 with stained glass)**
12. **If you fail a puzzle that isn't the blaze puzzle during a dungeon, it will kick you to the lobby, say you got wiped, sends you to limbo, then gives you a fake ban that can only be removed by relaunching the game. :3**

</details>

run the command '/kittymod config' ingame to enable/disable stuff!
